results.overview: A reflection on incommunicability and loneliness. The short film juxtaposes two protagonists inhabiting the same space, exploring how idiosyncrasy governs human relationships today and showing how the only possible contact is often mutual disturbance.

results.title: Sleeping Dogs Lie
results.overview: In the wake of his first breakout film role, Parker and his costar secure an invitation to the most elite getaway in the industry. But soon after their arrival, the tenor of the event shifts, exposing secrets that haunt him, and Parker must choose whether to speak up, risking his reputation (or worse) or to let sleeping dogs lie.

results.title: Midnight Broadcast
results.overview: A late-night radio host receives a mysterious call from someone claiming to be listening to tomorrow's broadcast, and soon realizes the caller may be trying to prevent a tragedy before it happens.

results.title: The Tale of the Cave Mosque: Libya
results.overview: A historical documentary exploring the unique archaeological and spiritual value of the "Cave Mosque" in Libya, highlighting its historic architectural style carved deep within the earth. The film traces the stories of its inception, the historical mysteries embedded in its ancient walls, and the social and religious role it played through the ages, relying on expert testimonies and exclusive documentary footage investigating this remarkable Islamic landmark.

results.title: Libya: A Tune of Reconciliation
results.overview: A touching cultural documentary following poet "Ahmed Al-Obeidi" from the East and composer "Hanan Al-Rowaiei" from the West, as they unite to recall the history of Libyan social reconciliations during times of conflict. Together, they revive and craft an epic theatrical and poetic masterpiece centered around Libya's most famous historical peace accord, the "Harabi Covenant," using art and music to echo messages of peace, social harmony, and national unity.

results.title: In between dreams
results.overview: In Between Dreams is an intimate autobiographical documentary following a filmmaker from Kolkata as he wanders through Paris, searching for memories of his childhood and home. One day, he lands in Parc des Buttes-Chaumont where he encounters strangers gathered in music and conversation. As they speak of dreams, language, and memory, the park becomes a living crossroads of migration and longing. In communicating their dreams and memories to one another, they create a fragile but powerful sense of a shared belonging. And in that exchange, the filmmaker too finds what he had been searching for, a familiar feeling that he could call his home.

results.title: The Mujahid of the Mountain Khalifa Bin Askar
results.overview: A historical documentary capturing the epic struggle of the heroic Libyan Mujahid, "Khalifa Bin Askar," who led the armed resistance against the Italian occupation in Libya's Western Mountains. The film sheds light on the prominent strategic battles he commanded against the Italian invasion, while also highlighting a significant pan-Arab dimension: his unity with Tunisian resistance fighters in numerous battles against French colonialism in Tunisia. The documentary culminates in a dramatic conclusion, exploring the treacherous deception that led to Bin Askar’s capture by the Italians, leading up to his execution and martyrdom.

results.title: Memory of the Sands: Fascist Concentration Camps in Libya
results.original_title: ذاكرة الرمال - المعتقلات الفاشية في ليبيا
results.overview: "Memory of the Sands" is a historical documentary that sheds light on a forgotten period of Arab history: the brutal genocide inflicted upon the Libyan people by the Italian Fascist forces between 1929 and 1934.The film documents the horrific atrocities committed under the "scorched-earth" policy led by General Rodolfo Graziani, which aimed to crush the Libyan resistance. It explores the establishment of notorious desert concentration camps that held tens of thousands of innocent civilians—including women, children, and the elderly—resulting in mass starvation and deadly disease. Through rare historical archives and moving testimonies from the last remaining survivors, the documentary serves as a vital historical record, reviving the memory of a dark, overlooked chapter of colonial history.
